# hallpass_oidc_provider (Resource)

A single sign-on (OIDC) provider for the console. Register `redirect_uri` at the provider. Map its groups to operator roles with `hallpass_oidc_group_mapping`. Identities are matched by issuer and subject, never by email. Import with the provider ID (the client secret is not imported; set it again).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_oidc_provider" "entra" {
  slug          = "entra"
  display_name  = "Microsoft Entra ID"
  issuer        = "https://login.microsoftonline.com/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/v2.0"
  client_id     = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  client_secret = var.entra_client_secret
  groups_claim  = "groups"
  provisioning  = "jit"
  jit = {
    tenants = ["00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"]
  }
}

output "entra_redirect_uri" {
  value = hallpass_oidc_provider.entra.redirect_uri
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) OAuth client ID.
- `display_name` (String) Name on the sign-in button.
- `issuer` (String) Issuer URL (exact, as in the discovery document).
- `slug` (String) Short name used in sign-in URLs.

### Optional

- `acr_values` (List of String) ACR values to request.
- `allow_cross_origin_endpoints` (Boolean) Allow token and key endpoints on another origin than the issuer.
- `allow_private_network` (Boolean) Allow the provider's endpoints on private or loopback addresses (self-hosted IdPs).
- `ca_bundle_pem` (String) Extra CA certificates (PEM) for the provider's TLS.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth client secret (write-only in HallPass; kept in state). Omit for public clients.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the sign-in button is offered.
- `end_session_enabled` (Boolean) Also sign out at the provider when signing out of HallPass.
- `groups_claim` (String) ID token claim that lists the user's groups.
- `jit` (Attributes) Who may be created at first sign-in (`provisioning = "jit"`); at least one restriction is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jit))
- `provisioning` (String) `preprovisioned` (operators must exist) or `jit` (created at first sign-in, limited by `jit`).
- `scopes` (List of String) Scopes to request (HallPass default when unset).
- `stepup_fallback` (String) When the provider does not report a recent sign-in: `none` or `local_totp` (ask for the operator's HallPass TOTP).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Provider ID (`oidc_…`).
- `redirect_uri` (String) Exact redirect URI to register at the provider.

<a id="nestedatt--jit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jit`

Optional:

- `email_domains` (Set of String) Verified email domains.
- `groups` (Set of String) Required group values (any of them).
- `hosted_domains` (Set of String) Google Workspace domains (`hd`).
- `tenants` (Set of String) Microsoft Entra ID tenant IDs (`tid`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Provider ID (set client_secret again after import)
terraform import hallpass_oidc_provider.entra oidc_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j
```
